WITH sma_10001_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', activity_date) AS metric_time__month
    , member_id AS __monthly_buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN monthly_order_count >= 2 THEN member_id END AS __monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."member_month_valid_orders" member_month_valid_orders_src_10000
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(subq_8.metric_time__month, subq_14.metric_time__month) AS metric_time__month
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(CAST(subq_14.monthly_repeat_buyer_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_14.monthly_buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS monthly_repeat_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10001_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_8
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10001_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_14
ON
  subq_8.metric_time__month = subq_14.metric_time__month
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(subq_8.metric_time__month, subq_14.metric_time__month)
answer: 统计范围为青禾 CRM 会员账户，按 2026 年 7 月、8 月两个完整自然月分别统计，采用全门店口径。月内购买会员数指该自然月内至少有一笔有效订单的账户数；月内复购会员数指该自然月内至少有兩笔有效订单的账户数；月内复购率按“月内复购会员数 ÷ 月内购买会员数”计算。结果如下：2026 年 7 月，月内购买会员数 11 个账户，月内复购会员数 1 个账户，月内复购率 9.09%；2026 年 8 月，月内购买会员数 15 个账户，月内复购会员数 12 个账户，月内复购率 80.00%。两个月分母均不为零，因此复购率均为已定义值。多月数据应按月分别查看，不能把两个月人数直接相加作为跨月会员数。
question: 青禾 2026 年 7 月和 8 月的月内购买会员数、月内复购会员数和月内复购率，按月分别列出。
